info.title: IP6_Address
info.description: RESTful interface for AOS-CX switch software

address.description:
Reference Resource: [IP6_Address](#/IP6_Address)
Stores the statically configured IPv6 addresses and prefixes.

no-advertise.description: When set to `true`, the prefix wont be advertised.

no-autoconfig.description: When set to `true`, the prefix wont be used for address auto-configuration.

no-onlink.description: When set to `true`, router advertisement makes no statement about on-link or off-link properties of the prefix.

lifetime.description: Validity in seconds of the IPv6 route configured, which will be sent in RA messages. The value of 4294967295 seconds means that the entry will not expire.

no-advertise.description: When set to `true`, the route wont be advertised.

preference.description: The preference associated with the route advertised.

anycast_address.description: Configure the address as anycast address.

node_address.description: When set to `true`, address on the link is either manually configured or dynamically configured on reception of router advertisements.

origin.description: Specifies whether the IP address is system generated or user configured.

preferred_lifetime.description: The preferred validity of the IPv6 prefix associated with the address, which will be sent in RA messages. The validity of 4294967295 seconds mean, infinite lifetime. The default value depends on [preferred_lifetime](#/Port).

ra_prefix.description: When set to `true`, the prefix will be included in the RA messages.

ra_route.description: When set to `true`, the route will be included in the RA messages.

route_tag.description: The route tag value for connected route.

status.description: The status of the address with respect to IPv6 neighbor discovery. When set as `tentative`, an address whose uniqueness on a link is being verified. When an address is configured on a network interface (either manually or automatically), the address is initially in the tentative state. Such an address is not considered to be assigned to an interface. An interface discards received packets addressed to a tentative address, but accepts neighbor discovery packets related to duplicate address detection (DAD) for the tentative address. When set as `duplicate`, DAD finds that an address is not unique and it is moved to the duplicate state. Such an address cannot be used for sending and receiving data. When set as `preferred`, an address used to send and receive data packets from and to a network interface without any restriction on the upper layer protocols. When set as `deprecated`, the address becomes deprecated, when its preferred lifetime expires. The use of this address is discouraged, but not prohibited. When set as `invalid`, the address can no longer send or receive data packets. A valid address becomes invalid when its valid lifetime expires. An invalid address is removed from the network interface.

valid_lifetime.description: The validity(seconds) of IPv6 prefix associated with the address, which will be sent in RA messages. The validity of 4294967295 seconds mean, infinite lifetime. The default value depends on [valid_lifetime](#/Port).

parameters.name: Interface.name
parameters.description:
Reference Resource: [Port](#/Port)
The port name. For non-bonded ports, the port name is the same as the associated interface name. The name must otherwise be unique across all ports and interfaces of the system.

parameters.name: attributes
parameters.description: Columns to display.

parameters.name: depth
parameters.description: Depth to traverse.

parameters.name: selector
parameters.description: Select configuration, status and/or statistics. Default is all categories.

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: Filter rows by attribute values.  Format: attribute:value

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: Count the number of rows found.

parameters.name: If-None-Match
parameters.description: Entity-tag value for representation comparison (see RFC 7232 - Conditional Requests - section 3.2)
